meta.name: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
meta.description:
Boruto Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki, has enrolled in the Ninja Academy to learn the ways of the ninja. Now, as a series of mysterious events unfolds, Boruto’s story is about to begin!

Shows: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow, Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Will of Fire (English Dubbed), Naruto Shippuden the Movie: The Lost Tower (English Dubbed), Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Blood Prison (English Dubbed), The Last: Naruto the Movie (English Dubbed)
Available on: Pluto TV
